title: Implement hook system policy loading foundation
instructions: Implement the first executable foundation from references/initiatives/samantha-hook-system.md without executing hooks and without changing run logs or CLI behavior. Add a new core module src/core/hooks.ts plus focused tests in tests/hooks.test.ts. Keep this slice limited to Samantha-native hook schema constants, closed event/mode/status validation, hook policy validation, and loading hook policy plus referenced hook definition JSON files from a repository root. The loader must be read-only: it must not create, edit, delete, or write repository files. Missing hook policy should produce a disabled/no-hooks result rather than breaking existing Samantha flows. Validate that trust-gate events use fail-closed behavior, advisory events use fail-open behavior unless explicitly valid, command declarations are argv-style string arrays, context keys are explicit strings, stdout caps and timeout values are bounded, hook ids are stable repo-local ids, referenced hooks exist, hook events are known closed-schema names, and disabled hooks carry reasons. Do not add hook execution, context injection into worker prompts, run-log hook evidence, CLI commands, MCP support, plugin support, daemon/watch behavior, remote services, or repository hook artifacts in references/hooks/**. Tests should cover valid loading, absent policy behavior, invalid schema rejection, missing referenced hook rejection, trust/advisory failure behavior validation, and read-only policy loading using temporary directories.
expectedCommitSubject: feat: add hook policy loading foundation
